description: How far the crafter of a hero's weapon falls behind the hero. The hero fights the best dungeon, but a share of its fights are in the two level 1 dungeons, the only source of basic material. Players are expected to spend 30% to 50% of their fights there. One crafter at a time gets all the basic material it uses. It turns every unit into the best recipe it can make. Fees and crafting time are ignored.
